title: Split metadata
description: SEAM 1. data/splits/split_meta.json - the reproducibility record for the dataset split. Produced by Member 1; read by everyone and quoted directly in the report's Section 1 and reproducibility notes. Committed to git.

dataset_source.description: Where the raw data came from, for the report's citation.

class_names.description: FROZEN ordering. class_names[i] is the label for integer class i. Every per-class metric, confusion matrix axis and figure legend is indexed by this array. Re-sorting it invalidates every committed result.

seed.description: RNG seed used to draw the split. Every committed run uses 42.

stratified.description: True if class proportions were preserved across splits.

counts.description: Realised image counts per split. Goes straight into the report's Section 1 table.

per_class_counts.description: Optional {split: {class_name: count}}. Useful for discussing class imbalance in the confusion-matrix analysis.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of split_manifest.csv. If this does not match the file on disk, someone regenerated or hand-edited the split and every downstream result is stale.
